acceptance_predicates.description: Local validation rejects malformed, private, cross-project, duplicate, cyclic, orphaned, stale, and partial issue-series decompositions.
Validated creation is atomic and produces equivalent Git and SQLite task graphs and generated views.
No GitHub publication, credentials, signature, authentication, or external review is required for creation or acceptance.

definition_of_done: A locally validated issue-series manifest and dry-run/create command are implemented.
Valid decomposition atomically creates member ARs and one dependency-ordered finalizer with generated views.
Contract, property-or-fuzz, fault, concurrency, and bounded-model evidence are recorded locally.

gates.description: Locally reproducible evidence is the sole progression gate.

inputs.description: A structured privacy-safe issue-to-AR decomposition bound to repository identity.

outputs.description: An atomically persisted member graph and finalizer with deterministic generated views.
